description: Wimley-White whole-residue octanol hydrophobicity scale (ΔG_woct, kcal/mol), transfer from water to n-octanol. Charged states: ARG+, LYS+, HIS+, ASP-, GLU-. Values ordered in AWSEM 20-letter amino acid order.
source: Wimley, Creamer & White (1996) Biochemistry 35:5109-5124; summarized in White lab whole-residue hydrophobicity scale table https://blanco.biomol.uci.edu/hydrophobicity_scales.html
